item.title: Special Counsel Appointed by President to Cancel President's Trial? Controversy Over Self-Pardon Inevitable (대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령 재판 취소? 셀프 면죄부 논란 불가피)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea pushes for a new special counsel following its "suspicion of fabricated indictments under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration parliamentary investigation," legal circles have raised concerns that the party's attempt to grant the special counsel authority to revoke indictments in cases such as President Lee Jae-myung's Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool scandals constitutes "unconstitutional legislation." (더불어민주당이 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 국정 조사’에 이어 새 특검을 추진하면서 이재명 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 사건 등에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에 주는 특검법안을 추진하려는 것에 대해 법조계에서는 “위헌적 입법”이라는 지적이 제기됐다.)

A lawyer who previously served as a chief prosecutor stated, "Granting a special counsel the power to revoke indictments in cases it did not directly bring infringes on the judiciary's authority to hear cases and determine guilt or innocence. It amounts to the ruling party abusing its legislative power to destroy the constitutional principle of separation of powers." (검사장 출신 변호사는 “직접 기소하지 않은 사건에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에 부여하는 것은 사건을 심리해 유·무죄 여부를 판단하는 사법부 권한을 침해하는 것”이라며 “거대 여당이 입법권을 남용해 헌법이 정한 삼권분립 원칙을 파괴하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Another lawyer who formerly worked as a prosecutor said, "Even if the special counsel believes that the prosecution's investigation was unlawful and that fabricated indictments occurred, that has not been confirmed by a court. Determining the guilt or innocence of criminal facts or whether evidence collected and submitted by the prosecution was fabricated are matters for the judiciary to decide." He argued that a special counsel law should not allow the special counsel to arbitrarily judge cases indicted by the prosecution and revoke indictments. (검사 출신 변호사는 “특검 시각에서 검찰 수사가 위법했고, 조작 기소가 이뤄졌다고 하더라도 그건 법원에 의해 확정된 사실이 아니다”며 “범죄 사실에 대한 유·무죄 판단이나 검찰이 수집·제출한 증거가 조작됐는지 여부는 모두 사법부가 판단해야 할 사항”이라고 했다. 특검이 검찰이 기소한 사건에 대해 자의적으로 판단해 공소 취소를 할 수 있게 특검법을 만들어서는 안 된다는 것이다.)

An indictment revocation is a procedure in which a prosecutor voluntarily withdraws an indictment. It can be carried out under the direction of the Minister of Justice to the Prosecutor General. Under the Criminal Procedure Act, an indictment can be revoked before the first trial verdict is rendered. How the Democratic Party's hardliners have structured this in the special counsel law remains unclear. Some speculate that the scope of indictment revocation could be extended to after the first trial verdict. (공소취소는 검사가 제기한 공소를 자진해서 철회하는 절차다. 법무장관이 검찰총장을 지휘해 진행할 수 있다. 형사소송법에 따르면, 1심 판결 선고 전까지 공소를 취소할 수 있다. 이 부분에 대해 민주당 강경파들이 어떻게 특검법을 정리했는지는 명확하게 알려지지 않고 있다. 일각에서는 공소 취소 범위를 1심 선고 이후까지 넓힐 것이라는 얘기도 나온다.)

In the cases of the North Korea remittance and Daejang-dong scandals, the trial for President Lee Jae-myung has been suspended after the first trial due to his election as president. Meanwhile, former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young received a final guilty verdict from the Supreme Court in the North Korea remittance case. Former National Security Office Director Suh Hoon was acquitted in the first trial for the 2020 killing of a South Korean fishery official, but the second trial is ongoing. (대북 송금, 대장동 사건의 경우, 이재명 대통령에 대한 재판은 대통령 당선으로 1심이 중단된 상태다. 반면, 이화영 전 경기부지사는 대북 송금 사건으로 대법원에서 유죄 확정 판결을 받았다. 서훈 전 국가안보실장은 서해 공무원 피격 사건에서 1심 무죄를 선고받았지만 2심이 진행 중이다.)

A lawyer with 20 years of experience commented, "If a special law is created to allow a special counsel—not a court ruling—to overturn cases that the Supreme Court or lower courts have deemed guilty through indictment revocation, that would be unconstitutional legislation." A lawyer who once served as a high-ranking judge added, "There is no precedent for the National Assembly's special committee on parliamentary investigations to probe cases that have already resulted in guilty verdicts, and for the Assembly to enable a special counsel to revoke indictments based on those findings." The Democratic Party included similar indictment revocation provisions in the Marine Corps special counsel law, but controversy was avoided when the special counsel, after a first-instance acquittal of former Marine Corps investigative chief Colonel Park Jeong-hoon, withdrew the appeal instead of exercising the indictment revocation power. (이에 대해 20년 경력의 한 변호사는 “대법원이나 하급심 법원에서 유죄로 판단한 사건을 법원 판결이 아니라 특검의 공소 취소로 뒤집을 수 있게 특별법(특검법)을 만든다면 위헌적 입법”이라고 했다. 고위 법관 출신 변호사는 “이미 유죄가 선고된 사건을 국회 국정조사 특별위원회가 조사 대상으로 삼고, 국회가 조사 결과를 바탕으로 특검이 공소 취소를 할 수 있게 하는 것은 전례가 없는 일”이라고 했다. 민주당은 해병 특검법에도 공소 취소 관련 조항을 넣었지만, 항명 혐의로 군사재판을 받던 박정훈 전 해병대 수사단장에게 1심 무죄가 선고된 후 특검이 공소 취소 권한을 쓰지 않고 항소 취하를 하며 논란을 피해 갔다.)

If the special counsel law passes the National Assembly plenary session, controversy is inevitable over President Lee potentially opening the door for "self-pardon" regarding his own cases. The law takes effect after approval by the Cabinet, which is presided over by the President. Legal circles argue, "If the President is involved in launching a special counsel that handles his own cases, and that special counsel can exercise the power to revoke indictments, it would be difficult to avoid criticism that it amounts to him resolving his own affairs." (특검법이 국회 본회의를 통과할 경우, 이 대통령이 본인 사건에 대한 ‘셀프 공소 취소’의 여지를 열어 놨다는 논란도 불가피하다. 특검법은 이 대통령이 주재하는 국무회의 재가를 거쳐 시행된다. 법조계에서는 “대통령이 자신의 사건을 다루는 특검 출범에 관여하고, 그 특검이 공소 취소 권한을 행사할 수 있다면 사실상 자기 사건을 스스로 정리하는 것과 다름없다는 비판을 피하기 어렵다”는 말이 나온다.)

The authority to appoint a special counsel lies with the President. The prospect of President Lee appointing the special counsel under the new law pushed by the Democratic Party is also expected to spark controversy. In particular, if the special counsel revokes indictments in cases related to President Lee, such as the North Korea remittance case, a conflict of interest arises. A current senior prosecutor stated, "It would mean the special counsel appointed by the President cancels the trial in which the President is the defendant. It seems difficult to persuade even the prosecution leadership, which operates according to the current administration's wishes, on the issue of indictment revocation, so they are using the special counsel to work on 'burying Lee Jae-myung.'" (특검 임명권은 대통령에게 있다. 민주당이 추진하는 새 특검법에 따라 이 대통령이 해당 특검을 임명하게 되는 것도 논란이 될 전망이다. 특히 특검이 ‘대북 송금 사건’ 등 이 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 경우 이해 충돌 문제가 있다는 것이다. 현직 부장검사는 “대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령이 피고인으로 있는 재판을 취소하는 셈”이라며 “현 정부 뜻대로 움직이는 검찰 지휘부를 상대로도 ‘공소 취소’ 문제는 설득이 어려워 보이니 특검이라는 조직으로 ‘이재명 죄 지우기’ 작업을 하려는 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to introduce the special counsel law as soon as possible. Lawmaker Park Seong-joon stated today, "About 150 political prosecutors targeted President Lee Jae-myung in a witch hunt. Since the state investigation has confirmed the fabricated indictments by the political prosecution under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, we will thoroughly uncover the truth through a special counsel." The special parliamentary committee is set to conclude its activities with a plenary session on the 30th. (민주당은 특검법을 최대한 빠른 시일 내 발의한다는 입장이다. 박성준 의원은 이날 “150여 명의 정치 검찰이 이재명 대통령을 목표로 두고 토끼몰이에 나섰다”며 “국정조사를 통해 윤석열 정권 정치 검찰의 조작 기소 실태가 확인된 만큼 특검으로 확실하게 진상을 규명하겠다”고 했다. 국조특위는 30일 전체회의를 끝으로 활동을 마무리할 예정이다.)

☞Indictment Revocation (☞공소 취소)

A procedure stipulated in Article 255 of the Criminal Procedure Act, referring to the prosecutor voluntarily withdrawing an indictment. The indictment can be revoked before the first trial verdict is rendered, and it can be carried out under the direction of the Minister of Justice to the Prosecutor General. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho stated in June of last year, "Indictment revocation is the right approach for the President's case," but later in March said, "I have no intention or thought of directing such a revocation." (형사소송법 제255조에 규정된 절차로, 검사가 제기한 공소를 스스로 철회하는 것을 의미한다. 1심 판결 선고 전까지 공소를 취소할 수 있고, 법무장관이 검찰총장을 지휘해 진행할 수 있다. 정성호 법무장관은 지난해 6월 “대통령 사건은 공소 취소가 맞다”고 했다가 지난 3월 “(공소 취소를) 지휘할 의도나 생각이 전혀 없다”고 한 바 있다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae "Swiftly Push for Special Counsel on Manipulated Indictments"... Some in Party "Worried About Backlash Ahead of Elections" (정청래 “조작기소 특검 신속 추진”… 당 일각 “선거 앞 역풍 우려”)
item.description:
As the National Assembly's special committee on the "suspected manipulated indictments by the Yoon Suk-yeol administration," led by the Democratic Party of Korea, has effectively concluded its activities, leader Chung Cheong-rae stated on the 29th, "We will now swiftly push for a special counsel." However, ahead of the June 3 local elections, some within the party are reportedly voicing opinions that "forcing a special counsel on top of the parliamentary investigation could negatively impact the elections." In particular, some election camps in the conservative-leaning Yeongnam region have reportedly conveyed concerns that "with the opposition defining the special counsel as a means to 'cancel the indictment' of the president's case, passing the special counsel bill before the elections could trigger a backlash." <<>> Park Seong-joon, the ruling party floor leader for the special committee, said at a press conference on the same day, "Since the parliamentary investigation confirmed the reality of the Yoon Suk-yeol administration's political prosecution manipulating indictments, we will thoroughly uncover the truth through a special counsel." He also mentioned that preparations are in place to introduce the special counsel bill at any time. A source from the special committee stated, "We need to introduce the special counsel bill in early May and process it in a plenary session before the local elections." Hardliners within the Democratic Party are reportedly pushing to quickly advance the special counsel while momentum exists, right after the conclusion of the parliamentary investigation. <<>> Nevertheless, some within the party are saying, "Since the special counsel could negatively impact the local elections in regions like Yeongnam, the timing of its processing needs careful consideration." In fact, a source from election camps in the Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam areas remarked, "Although the party belatedly argued that the parliamentary investigation was not for canceling the indictment, the public sees the special counsel as a move to erase the president's trial. Since our support base wants it, the special counsel should proceed, but it should be postponed until after the elections." <<>> As a result, cautious views on the special counsel are reportedly emerging within the leadership as well. Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun also said regarding the timing of introducing and processing the special counsel bill, "Additional discussions within the leadership are needed," adding, "There are the local elections to consider, and we also have to account for physical impacts, so a decision hasn't been made yet." A source from the leadership within the National Assembly also stated, "We need to discuss further whether to process it before the local elections." (더불어민주당이 주도하는 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 특별위원회가 사실상 활동을 마무리한 가운데, 정청래 대표는 29일 “이제 특검을 신속히 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다. 하지만 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 당 일각에선 “국정조사에 이어 특검까지 강행하면 선거에 악영향을 미친다”는 의견이 나오는 것으로 알려졌다. 특히 보수 세가 강한 영남권의 일부 선거 캠프에선 “야당이 특검을 ‘대통령 사건의 공소 취소용’으로 규정하고 있는 상황에서 선거 전에 특검법을 통과시키면 역풍이 불 것”이라는 의견을 전달했다고 한다.)

item.title: Big Shots and Ex-Presidential Aides Flood In… The Arena Expands for the June 3 By-Elections (거물급·靑참모 대거 참전… 판 커진 6·3 재보선)
item.description:
With nine incumbent lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties resigning on the 29th to run in the June 3 local elections, the number of constituencies for National Assembly by-elections has been set at 14. This marks the second-largest scale since the regular by-elections system was established in 2000. In this election, figures such as Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party (Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi), Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party (Buk-gu, Busan), Song Young-gil, former leader of the Democratic Party (Yeonsu-gu-gap, Incheon), and Lee Kwang-jae, former Gangwon Province governor from the Democratic Party (Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi), are running, drawing attention to whether these "big shots" from both sides will enter the National Assembly. (6·3 지방선거에 출마하는 여야 현역 국회의원 9명이 29일 의원직을 사퇴함에 따라 국회의원 재보궐선거 지역구가 14곳으로 확정됐다. 재보선이 정례화된 2000년 이후 역대 두 번째로 큰 규모다. 이번 선거에는 조국 조국혁신당 대표(경기 평택을), 한동훈 국민의힘 전 대표(부산 북갑), 송영길 전 더불어민주당 대표(인천 연수갑), 이광재 민주당 전 강원지사(경기 하남갑) 등이 출마하면서 여야 ‘빅샷’의 국회 입성 여부도 관심사다.)

On this day, from the Democratic Party, eight lawmakers—Choo Mi-ae (Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi), Park Chan-dae (Yeonsu-gu-gap, Incheon), Wi Seong-gon (Seogwipo, Jeju), Jeon Jae-soo (Buk-gu, Busan), Min Hyung-bae (Gwangsan-eul, Gwangju), Park Soo-hyun (Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang, South Chungcheong), Lee Won-taek (Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul, North Jeolla), and Kim Sang-wook (Nam-gu-gap, Ulsan)—stepped down from their seats to run for mayor or governor. From the People Power Party, Rep. Choo Kyung-ho (Dalseong, Daegu), a candidate for Daegu mayor, resigned. Combined with the five by-elections already confirmed earlier, a total of 14 constituencies will hold by-elections. (이날 민주당에선 추미애(경기 하남갑), 박찬대(인천 연수갑), 위성곤(제주 서귀포), 전재수(부산 북갑), 민형배(광주 광산을), 박수현(충남 공주·부여·청양), 이원택(전북 군산·김제·부안을), 김상욱(울산 남갑) 의원 등 8명이 시도지사 출마를 위해 의원직에서 물러났다. 국민의힘에선 대구시장 후보인 추경호(대구 달성) 의원이 사퇴했다. 앞서 재보선이 확정된 5곳까지 합쳐 총 14곳에서 재보선이 치러지게 됐다.)

The ruling party aims for a landslide victory in both the local elections—held a year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration—and the by-elections. Since 13 out of the 14 by-election constituencies were previously held by the Democratic Party, the goal is to retain them all. The Democratic Party has strategically nominated former presidential office aides in four of the eight constituencies where candidates have been confirmed so far: Kim Nam-guk, former Presidential Secretary for Public Communication, in Ansan-gap, Gyeonggi; Kim Nam-joon, former spokesperson, in Gyeyang-eul, Incheon; Jeon Eun-soo, former spokesperson, in Asan-eul, South Chungcheong; and Ha Jung-woo, former Senior Secretary for AI Future Strategy, in Buk-gu, Busan. However, some within the ruling party have commented that "the flood of key presidential office aides entering the race could also become a burden on the president." The People Power Party plans to nominate candidates most likely to win to counter the Democratic Party's legislative overreach. <<>> (여당은 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치르는 지방선거와 함께 재보선도 압승을 목표로 하고 있다. 재보선 14곳 중 13곳이 직전까지 민주당 지역구였기 때문에 전부 사수하겠다는 것이다. 민주당은 현재까지 후보를 확정한 8곳 중 4곳에 청와대 출신 후보를 전략공천했다. 경기 안산갑 김남국 전 국민소통비서관, 인천 계양을 김남준 전 대변인, 충남 아산을 전은수 전 대변인, 부산 북갑 하정우 전 AI미래기획수석 등이다. 다만 여권에서도 “청와대 핵심 참모들이 대거 나가면서 대통령에게도 부담이 될 것”이란 말도 나온다. 국민의힘은 민주당의 입법 폭주를 막기 위해 최대한 승리할 후보를 공천할 방침이다.)
